hero.title: Exquisite Images, Made With Care
hero.intro: Pluck Photography Studios is a Calgary photography studio specializing in portraits, family sessions, corporate headshots, maternity and weddings. We photograph people the way they would like to be remembered.

story.heading: Photography That Feels Like You
paragraphs: We built the studio around one belief: everyone photographs well when they are lit properly, directed kindly and given a little time. Most people who tell us they hate having their picture taken leave with a favourite.
From a first birthday to a wedding day, from a headshot to a maternity session, the approach is the same — considered light, honest direction, and hand editing on every frame we deliver.

values.title: Precision
values.copy: Light, lens and timing are decided deliberately. Nothing in the frame is there by accident.

values.title: Patience
values.copy: We wait for the real expression instead of asking for a performance. It takes longer and it shows.

values.title: Care
values.copy: You are guided from the first email to the final delivery, so the session feels easy rather than exposing.

hero.title: Services & Sessions
hero.intro: Studio and on-location photography across seven specialisms, each with its own pace, lighting approach and delivery.

steps.title: Enquire
steps.copy: Tell us the occasion, the date and roughly what you have in mind.

steps.title: Plan
steps.copy: We agree a session type, wardrobe direction and a run of show.

steps.title: Photograph
steps.copy: You are lit, directed and given time. No rushing, no forced smiles.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.copy: Hand-edited high resolution images in a private online gallery.
